entries.headline: Suisei Bloom announced: an amnesiac girl awaits rescue in a space resort in this survival, exploration and dialogue game
entries.summary: Solo developer MITOH has unveiled the Steam page for Suisei Bloom. Players take the role of Mint, a girl with amnesia, managing hunger and oxygen in a space resort whose systems have stopped working while awaiting rescue and investigating her own past and the resort's history. The game is planned as a free release on PC (Steam), with no date set.

entries.headline: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds begins Season 2 with one-on-one Duel Mode and multiple crossovers announced

entries.headline: ARC Raiders reaches a seven-month Steam concurrent-player high after its 2.0 update
entries.summary: IGN reports that ARC Raiders' 2.0 Frozen Trail update, the new Pendola Pass map, a grappling hook and the October 8–12 free weekend drove Steam concurrent players to 166,670, a seven-month high. The update is available on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

entries.headline: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen review awards 8/10 and cites more than 20 hours of expansion content

entries.headline: Nivalis Nights lead writer says this is not a relaxing life sim: players must earn their comfort
